# Penn State University Libraries Guides

> Comprehensive research guides and resource directories for Penn State University students and faculty, covering academic databases, citation styles, and specialized research materials.

Penn State Libraries provides subject-specific research guides and access to academic databases through LibApps. The guides cover foundational research skills, citation formats, and specialized collections including geospatial resources and archival materials.

## Key Topics

- Penn State University Libraries
- Academic databases
- Library resources
- Database access
- Citation styles
- CSE citation
- Subject guides
- Research guides
- Geospatial resources
- Historic maps
- Aerial photography
- Authentication
- Online learning
- Library guides
- Quick reference

## Database & Resource Access

- [A-Z Databases](https://guides.libraries.psu.edu/az/databases): Penn State Libraries A-Z database directory for accessing academic resources

## Citation & Research Styles

- [CSE Citation Systems - CSE Quick Citation Guide](https://guides.libraries.psu.edu/CSE): Quick reference guide for CSE citation style by Council of Science Editors

## Specialized Collections & Geospatial Resources

- [Maps & Geospatial: Aerial Photographs (Historic)](https://guides.libraries.psu.edu/aerialphotographs): Research guide for historic aerial photographs and geospatial archival materials

## User Support & Getting Started

- [Online Students Use of the Library](https://guides.libraries.psu.edu/onlinestudentlibraryguide): Getting started guide for Penn State online students accessing library resources remotely
